title: Resilience runway and initiative-aging policy: signal portfolio, gating automations, and sunset rules
creator: Asha Kapoor
description:
Define and implement an initiative-aging policy and resilience runway scorecard that ties error-budget consumption, SLI drift, and initiative velocity into automated gating for rollouts and a standardized sunset/rehab path. Current problem: we have many reliability initiatives that linger in flight without clear re-evaluation cadence; error-budget burn signals are sometimes buried in dashboards and do not consistently trigger roadmap or rollout changes. This leads to long-lived half-complete workstreams and weaker control of customer-facing SLOs.

Goal: produce a playbook and supporting console automation so PMs and Eng owners can: 1) see a single resilience runway score per initiative; 2) get automated gating actions (pause/canary-throttle/rollback) when predefined thresholds are hit; 3) have a documented aging and sunset policy that retires stale initiatives or moves them into a rehab backlog with assigned owners. Deliverables include a PRD, console dashboard iteration, webhook-based automation runbook, and a pilot with three cross-functional initiatives.

Scope: reliability/SLO initiatives across Hosted API, Dedicated, and Private. Focus initially on high-impact SLIs (availability, p99 latency for generate endpoints, token-generation failures, and embedding correctness regressions). Excludes infra-only maintenance tasks that do not affect customer-facing SLIs.

Out of scope: reworking existing SLI definitions themselves (we will reference current SLIs) and full org-wide rollout automation — start with pilot and safety constraints.
acceptance_criteria: Definition of a resilience runway score (0-100) that combines: weighted error-budget remaining, SLI trend (30-day slope), initiative velocity (completed story points/week), and customer-impact multiplier

Cookbook with threshold rules that map score ranges to automated actions: green (>75) no action; amber (50-75) alert + PM re-eval; red (25-50) pause new rollouts + required mitigation plan; critical (<25) auto-throttle or rollback per policy
Console dashboard prototype that displays score per initiative, historical trend, linked runbooks, and primary owner
Automation prototype (webhook + orchestration task) that can throttle a canary route and post a rollback suggestion to the initiative thread
Pilot executed on three initiatives with post-pilot report: metrics, false-positive rate, operator feedback, and recommended tuning
Aging/sunset playbook that defines: inactivity window, rehab flow, owner reassignment, and criteria for archival
steps: Workshop with SRE/Platform/PM leads to agree on weighting model and SLI set (week 1)
Draft PRD and get stakeholder sign-off (week 2)
Design console dashboard mockups and link patterns to runbooks (week 3)
Implement score calculation backend (ENG) and small SQL/telemetry extractor (week 4-6)
Build webhook automation for gating actions and safety overrides (week 6-8)
Pilot deployment on three initiatives and collect feedback (week 9)
Iterate and prepare rollout playbook + training (week 10-11)
Hand-off to Reliability Program for recurring cadence and quarterly review (week 12)
